limitations: L1: A flow cell, comprising: a patterned substrate including depressions separated by interstitial regions and including a bonding region;
L2: sequencing surface chemistry attached to each of the depressions, the sequencing surface chemistry including: a functionalized coating layer; and a primer grafted to the functional coating layer;

L3: a non-grafted hydrogel on at least the sequencing surface chemistry, the non-grafted hydrogel selected from the group consisting of crosslinked polyacrylamide, an agarose gel, and crosslinked polyethylene glycol;
L4: a lid attached to the patterned substrate at the bonding region;
L5: a flow channel defined between the patterned substrate and the lid;
L6: a spacer layer bonding the lid to the bonding region;

L7: the non-grafted hydrogel is the crosslinked polyethylene glycol, and wherein the crosslinked polyethylene glycol includes a polyethylene glycol macromer crosslinked with a reactive chain end selected from the group consisting of acrylate, methacrylate, allyl ether, maleimide, vinyl sulfone, N-hydroxysuccinimide ester, and vinyl ether;
